Aurea 1.1.0 (2236)
• Auto Caption Star is now in the bottom bar, with styles, presets and conversion to editable layers.
• Aurea Enhance reduces noise and compression artifacts. Look Studio imports compatible After Effects color presets in .ffx format.
• Camera Tracker and Motion Tracker have dedicated panels. Rotobrush has a redesigned interface.
• Seven editable 3D models, animatable 3D Spacing and 3D Money Rain.
• Twitch and 3D Text are free. New PsykoBlobs and PsykoStripes effects.
• Community feed with photos and videos, replies, notifications and downloadable projects.
• Composition zoom keeps the current frame. Deleting a clip with the magnet off keeps other clips in place.
• Text layer names follow their content. Timeline optimizations and a fix for 3D cloud lighting.
